result.analyst_notes: Brief teaser page dominated by links. First-person plural voice, aspirational wording; community is addressed first and repeatedly through 'stronger communities', housing affordability and 'long-term economic growth'. Customers and sustainability appear only in passing. Employees appear only as a recruiting prompt. Commitments are stated absolutely ('We're building', 'We're helping'), with no hedging.
